hero.title: Invest for pretend. Learn for real.
hero.lead: Build portfolios with B3 stocks and REITs, follow real quotes and see how the news moves prices.

stage.title: Seven different tools. One screen.
stage.lead: Today, investors jump between their broker, news sites, charts and simulators. Here, everything talks to each other.

how.title: From the headline to the decision, in four moves.
how.lead: The path an experienced investor follows by heart, organized for people who are just starting.

build.title: Build
build.text: Create a portfolio with pretend money and pick real B3 stocks and REITs.

follow.title: Follow
follow.text: See real quotes, always with the time of each price. No real-time promises.

relate.title: Relate
relate.text: News shows up on the asset chart, classified as positive, neutral or negative.

learn.title: Learn
learn.text: Compare what you decided with what happened in the market and find out what you would do differently.

portfolios.title: Two ways to test an idea.

live.title: Live portfolio
live.text: Buy and sell now, with the latest available quote. The portfolio moves along with the market.

historic.title: Historical portfolio
historic.text: Pick a date in the past, build the portfolio and see what it would be worth today.
historic.quote: If I had invested, would I have gained or lost?

news.title: News with context, not with noise.
news.lead: Each article is linked to the assets it mentions and classified by tone. On the chart, you see what happened to the price afterwards.
news.note: We show possible relations, never certainties. Scenarios are educational estimates, not advice.

positive.title: Positive
positive.text: A favorable tone for the asset, such as profits above expectations.

neutral.title: Neutral or uncertain
neutral.text: A relevant fact with no clear direction, or an effect that is still hard to predict.

negative.title: Negative
negative.text: An unfavorable tone, such as a rule change that weighs on the sector.

stock.title: Stock
stock.text: A piece of a company. You gain when it grows in value and when it pays dividends and interest on equity.

reit.title: Real estate fund (FII)
reit.text: Shares of a fund that invests in real estate, such as warehouses and offices, and usually pays income every month.

tip.title: Ending in 11 does not mean FII.
tip.text: ETFs and units also end in 11. That is why each asset here has its class set at registration, like at brokers.

noMoney.title: No real money
noMoney.text: Every operation is simulated. There is no broker, no buy order and no real payment.

education.title: Education, not advice
education.text: We show scenarios and statistics. Recommending what to buy is regulated by the CVM, and that does not happen here.

password.title: Protected password
password.text: We only store a hash of your password, made with argon2id. Not even the team can read it.

privacy.title: Your data, your rules
privacy.text: You will be able to request the export or deletion of your data, as required by the LGPD.

cta.title: Your first portfolio starts with zero risk.
cta.lead: Create your free account and start learning from the real market.
